newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Explorers Index falls 3.31 pct in week.
newsitem.headline: Australian Explorers Index falls 3.31 pct in week.

text.p: Perth stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index struggled in the week to Friday, falling 107.7 points or 3.31 percent. The All Ordinaries Index rose 0.69 percent.
May 2 Apr 25 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.
Eyres Reed analyst Glen Colgan said the fall came despite a flood of quarterly exploration reports, with falls outstripping gains by seven to two.

Best performances in the week included thinly traded Kurnalpi Gold emerging gold producer Gindalbie Gold, copper hopeful Majestic Resources, and Titan Resources, which rose in anticipation of results from their drilling at the Goodyear nickel discovery.
Colgan said fall were recorded across the board, with recent strong performers running out of steam including Pharaoh Metals, Money Mining, Helix Resources and Nugold Hill.
